text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 adds the new trace hook usage to the dashboard sample but it still references the old `traceContext` shim. Can someone sync with the SDK snippet owners? Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/console/obsv/dashboards#sample
chris: on it. I'll update the Node and Python snippets to use the `traceHook({service:'...'})` pattern. Any preference for `traceHook` vs `tracing.hook`? :thinking:
leo: We standardized on `traceHook` in SDK v2.2, but docs still have a mix. Recommend `traceHook` and add a short compatibility note for v1 users.
sam: Also, the cost/latency dashboard example still uses `latency_ms` — we've split that into `p50_latency_ms` and `p95_latency_ms`. The exported SQL and the dashboard screenshot need updates.
maria: Good catch. Chris, can you include both p50/p95 examples and a 1-liner explaining the aggregation change?
chris: Yep. Will update snippets and the export.sql. Also found a broken internal link: `/console/obsv/sample-embed` should redirect to `/console/observability/embed-samples`. I'll add a redirect entry in the docs config and ping infra for an nginx rule if needed.
ashley: Assigning reviewers: @leo + @sam for snippet correctness, @ashley for UX copy. Can we aim for reviews by EOD tomorrow? :pray:
leo: I can review tonight. Sam will handle the SQL/screenshot check tomorrow AM.
docs-bot: PR created by chris: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — labels: ["docs", "observability", "urgent"]
maria: Also, please grep for other `latency_ms` occurrences so we don't leave stale examples.
sam: running quick grep now, will paste results.
sam: Found 5 occurrences: docs/console/obsv/metrics.md, docs/console/obsv/dashboards/export.sql, docs/console/examples/perf-dashboard.md, docs/snippets/latency-example.yaml, docs/api/metrics-v1.md
chris: I'll update the two snippet files and the dashboard export. For metrics.md and api/metrics-v1.md — suggest adding a deprecation note and a pointer to the new fields.
maria: Plan: chris updates snippets + redirect; leo + sam review; docs-bot will auto-merge after approvals and green CI unless blockers.
leo: One more technical nit: current Node snippet uses `import tracing from '@redwood/sdk'` — we switched to named exports in v2. Please use this code block suggestion:

`````
import { traceHook } from '@redwood/sdk'
traceHook({ service: 'dashboard', env: process.env.NODE_ENV })
`````

chris: copying that into the PR. Thanks for the exact snippet.
maria: 👍 I've scheduled a quick sync in 15 minutes if anyone wants to join — otherwise update thread when PR is ready.
chris: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821/files — ready for review :eyes:
leo: Reviewed and left one line-note about screenshot alt text and caption. :+1:
sam: Verified the SQL changes and screenshot. All good from my side. :thumbsup:
ashley: LGTM from UX. Merge when CI passes. :shipit:
docs-bot: CI passed — merging in 10s
maria: Great work team. I'll confirm the redirect is live and then close follow-ups in the tracker. Thanks everyone! :tada:
